F7 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
978 landmarks: a signed edge whose target is not among them is invisible here.
Chromatin covers four of nine lines, and they are the best-studied ones, so the
mechanism is tested where the data is best rather than where it is representative.
shRNA seed effects put construct signal into every signature, which inflates the
gene term and makes the interaction HARDER to explain, not easier.
DepMap expression and LINCS signatures come from different labs and stocks of
nominally the same lines.
A mechanism failing here failed on the best data this project has; that is not the
same as being absent from biology.
